text:
On Monzo’s **free UK plan**, an **Instant Access Savings Pot pays 2.80% AER (variable)**. That’s about **£28 on £1,000** left for a full year if the rate stays the same. You can withdraw whenever you like. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/savings-isas))

Monzo lists these rates by plan for its Savings Pots and equivalent Cash ISAs. Both columns are variable AER. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/savings-isas))

| Monzo plan | Instant Access | Select Access |
|---|---:|---:|
| Free | 2.80% | 3.45% |
| Extra (£3/month) | 3.15% | 3.45% |
| Perks (£9/month) | 3.55% | 3.70% |
| Max (from £19/month) | 3.80% | 3.70% |

**Select Access** requires a **£500 minimum deposit**. You keep the advertised rate if you make no more than **two withdrawals per year** from that Pot; a third withdrawal lowers the rate until the Pot’s anniversary. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/savings-isas))

If you can leave the money for **three years**, Monzo also offers **5.25% AER fixed** on all four plans, with a £500 minimum deposit. Interest is paid at maturity, and closing early means losing some interest. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/savings-isas))
